criterion: Render gross, costs, net, benchmark net, alpha, confidence interval, drawdown, turnover, fidelity, and sample; failed/insufficient results cannot be hidden by default sorting.
test_result: 20 cockpit tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed. Cost/net and benchmark-alpha identities are checked, and all records remain visible with failed/insufficient rows first.
evidence_scope: Synthetic rows for verified, failed, and under-sampled strategies, including invalid arithmetic rejection.
operational_limits: The caller supplies outcomes and intervals; this component does not calculate returns or confidence bounds.
Rows are comparable only if the upstream evaluation contract uses aligned periods, horizons, benchmark, cost schedule, and fidelity.
No profitability or live-trading claim is produced by this table.
